__comment: Lower half of the two-block advanced condenser. Legacy 1.12.2 parent was block/orientable (top=condenser_adv_top, front=condenser_adv_front, side=condenser_adv_side). The port kept the TOP column but dropped FACING, so the orientable mapping is expanded to an explicit cube here: front on the fixed north face, side elsewhere, ground face reuses the side (never seen).
